body.statement: If \(\sqrt n(\widehat o_n-o)\Rightarrow N(0,\operatorname{diag}(o)-oo^\top)\) and \(F\) is differentiable at \(o\), then \[\sqrt n\{F(\widehat o_n)-F(o)\}\Rightarrow N\!\left(0,DF(o)[\operatorname{diag}(o)-oo^\top]DF(o)^\top\right).\]

attestation.note: The immutable core supplies the published book citation; the displayed statement is the finite-dimensional specialization used here.
